title: This app helps my life so much!!!
body: Lifestack really helps me plan my day. I lose focus easily, but by tracking energy and getting suggestions on Lifestack, my life gets better!
author: Zineb lamaamri

title: This is the only calendar that takes my health into account
body: I’ve been tracking my health data to boost my work efficiency, and I finally found an app that actually helps with that. The energy prediction has been a game-changer and added a nice boost to my productivity!
author: bligkizt
